cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Approve the Cover Story
cards.instruction: Get someone to endorse an explanation that protects the plan, reputation, or people involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If the caretaker asks, we were checking the props cupboard for extra seating. Can you stick to that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll tell him we borrowed his key to get the chairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stools. Chairs don't fit. And don't volunteer the key before he's asked about it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He lent it to me. He'll expect me to say how we used it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then say you lent it on to me. I'll explain the seating check. Please don't improvise any furniture.

reason: Keep the protective caretaker account but give B the imprecise chairs claim, so A's expert correction changes the agreed story. B's actual key responsibility forces a revised speaking arrangement.
